title: Magazine p. 58 (duplicate scan): Skylab-2 "UFO" Brazilian airstrip photo (NASA SL2-16-109)
description: Second copy of magazine page 58 with a speckled photograph (numbered 33) of an elongated object, captioned "'UFO' seen from Skylab-2. The elongated object is actually an airstrip in the Brazilian jungles. Enlargement of NASA photo SL2-16-109." Article text covers the 1973 Mansfield, Ohio helicopter sighting and claims about Skylab photographs, with handwritten notes "plate 33" and "plate 21 again!"
